meta.name: CCNL Materiali da Costruzione PMI — Lapidei (CONFAPI ANIEM)
meta.sector: Industria materiali da costruzione — Lapidei piccola industria

notes.text: SCOPE: Lapidei subsector only. Laterizi and Cemento subsectors have different level codes and salary structures; not modelled in this file.

SALARY MODEL: split. Art. 25 Lapidei: contingenza congelata e conglobata nei minimi (Minimo = paga base + contingenza frozen). fixed_allowances: EDR 10.33 EUR (tutti i livelli) and supermin.coll 7.75 EUR (livello 8 only).

SALARY HISTORY: 6 tranches from Allegato V (accordo 25.1.2024) and Art. 25 Lapidei dal 1.1.2025. Periods: 1.4.2019, 1.9.2020, 1.2.2021, 1.1.2022, 1.1.2024, 1.1.2025 (open). Source: CCNL testo completo FENEAL-UIL.
HOURLY DIVISOR: 174. Art. 24 Disciplina Lapidei: 'Le quote orarie degli elementi mensilizzati della retribuzione si ottengono dividendo gli elementi stessi per 174'.
ADDITIONAL MONTHS: 13 (tredicesima only). Art. 73 Disciplina Lapidei: gratifica natalizia annuale pari a una mensilita'.

SENIORITY: 5 scatti biennali (cadence 24 months). Art. 26 Lapidei: importi fissi calcolati al 5% dei minimi 1980 e trasformati in cifra fissa. Amounts: L1=12.76, L2=11.83, L3=10.14, L4=9.60, L5=8.99, L6=8.31, L7=7.57, L8=6.76.
SIGNATORIES: CONFAPI ANIEM + FILLEA-CGIL + FENEAL-UIL + FILCA-CISL. Testo definitivo signed 9 settembre 2025. Contract period 1.7.2022-30.6.2025.

SIMPLIFICATION: Apprenticeship not modelled. Art. 3 defines three periods (0-12 months 2 levels below, 12-24 months 1 level below, 24-36 months destination pay) with a special 18-month track for L6 and destination pay in period 3. The engine supports ApprenticeshipUnderClassification with levels_below periods, but L6's shorter duration and period-3 destination-pay override require per-destination customisation not yet extracted from source. Deferred pending dedicated source review.
SIMPLIFICATION: Work rules (overtime, leave, sickness) not modelled. Discipline lapidei spans multiple articles; scope deferred.

The Fondapi contractual contribution (5 EUR riparametrati a month) is owed on every run that pays the month, in full. The Scheda and the circolare operativa of Fondapi state no rule for a partly employed month, a part-time worker or the extra months: a partial month or part time pays the full amount, an extra-month run none.

limitation.remediation: Source the rule of the accordo of 10 November 2020 for a partial month and part time and model it, then remove this note.

notes.text: CIGO: the operai of the stone-working firms owe 3.30% ('operai delle imprese dell'industria e artigianato lapidei', D.Lgs. 148/2015 art. 13 c. 1 (Normattiva, text in force on 2026-10-14, https://www.normattiva.it/uri-res/N2Ls?urn:nir:stato:decreto.legislativo:2015-09-14;148~art13!vig=2026-10-14, snapshot sha256 3f7019a244e01d36ac8e7c9e25bcf058c777c8ed758418ba261d83867672c46a), lett. d); the industria table charges the 1.70% / 2.00% of lett. a-b, so the employer contributions of an operaio are understated by 1.60 or 1.30 points. Impiegati and quadri owe the 1.70% / 2.00% of lett. e-f the table already charges.

limitation.remediation: Model the CIGO of D.Lgs. 148/2015 art. 13 c. 1 by activity (edile, lapidei) apart from the tax sector, then remove this note.

reviews.scope: The minimi of the eight Lapidei levels against the testo definitivo of 9 September 2025.
findings: 40 minimi (eight levels, April 2019, September 2020, February 2021, January 2022 and January 2025) are printed in Art. 25 (PDF p. 96) and in the tables of Allegato V (PDF pp. 219-220): verified.

8 minimi of 1 January 2024 are not printed: the verbale of 25 January 2024 (Allegato V, PDF p. 219) prints the totals at 31 December 2023 and the increments; the minimo is the total plus the increment less the EDR (and the superminimo collettivo of level 8). Derived; every one matches the file.
The table of the verbale prints level 6 'a regime' at 1.935,75, the Art. 25 table at 1.935,76 (1.925,43 + 10,33): a one-cent misprint of the verbale; the file follows Art. 25.
The ruleset now names its source, the testo definitivo published by FENEAL-UIL, a signatory: source_type contracting_party instead of estimated.

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

provenance.note: Read from the PDF the url serves (sha256 7e9b29394505b6cd14125c88c6f0cc4ba78c14f026b546bb387636e40e42ee15). The Fondapi circolare operativa (https://fondapi.it/documenti/circolare-operativa-per-le-aziende-ccnl-materiali-da-costruzione, sha256 ac2edc6785ea1666af370263aff9499daf4bdeb8180d3196c97280dc4c4b8a88) quotes the accordo of 10 November 2020 and has the date of hire entered 'per tutti i lavoratori che verranno assunti successivamente al 01/01/2022': the contribution is owed for every worker, enrolled or not. The sources state no rule for a partial month, part time or the extra months: the engine owes it on the runs that pay the month, in full, and records a limitation. Assumed, not derived: its ruleset declares source_type 'estimated'.
